title: Etale constant charts for independently sized finitely presented local systems
statement: Let X be a scheme and let A be a commutative ring in the independent coefficient universe. Use the equivalent coefficient-sized sites and inclusion i of [def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism, def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], constant sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and finite presentation [def-sc-finitely-presented-module]. If a pro-etale module sheaf F is locally constant with finitely presented models on a covering sieve over every object, then there exist a family V_i of coefficient-sized etale objects and finitely presented A-modules M_i with F restricted to i(V_i) isomorphic to constant M_i on that slice. The objects i(V_i) cover the final object of the pro-etale site. This asserts only etale constant charts, not an etale antecedent or a comparison isomorphism.

proof.text: Apply the local-model hypothesis at the terminal AsSmall object. Index its covering sieve by pairs (U, arrow U to the terminal object in the sieve). This produces a coefficient-sized family U_i covering the final object, with finitely presented constant models M_i and slice isomorphisms e_i. No conversion to a scheme covering or index shrinking is needed.

Construct the set sheaf H_i of slice isomorphisms from F to constant M_i by gluing maps and inverses in sheafHom. Iterated slices identify its restriction to U_j with the Isom sheaf between constant M_j and constant M_i. The private fixedConstantHom helpers prove local injectivity using a finite generating set and local surjectivity by lifting its images and using injectivity of the constant-sheaf unit away from empty covers. Lift both maps of an isomorphism and refine by the two inverse equations; sheafification then identifies this Isom sheaf with constant (M_j isomorphic to M_i). Finite presentation supplies finite generation for both models. Hence every H_i is locally constant. All these assertions are proved by private helpers in the delivered Lean, in an arbitrary small-site universe.

The family H_i is jointly locally inhabited: on U_j use e_j followed by the constant-sheaf restriction isomorphism as a section of H_j. Apply coefficientLocallyConstant_etaleSections to obtain etale objects whose pro-etale images cover and which each have a section of some H_i. This only requires local constancy of set sheaves, and it permits the empty isomorphism sets that occur between different model types.

Each resulting section is an isomorphism F.over i(V_j) to the restriction of constant M_i. Compose with the inverse constant-sheaf restriction isomorphism. Retain the previously chosen finite-presentation proof of M_i; these are exactly the required charts.

mathlib_searches.query: Locally constant proetale sheaf of finitely presented modules is pulled back from etale sheaf with arbitrary coefficient universe
mathlib_searches.verdict: No etale/pro-etale comparison for independently sized module coefficients. Condensed discrete functors concern different sites.
The generic local isomorphism theorem assembles the parent proof but does not produce etale charts or the restricted comparison counit.

mathlib_searches.query: An etale covering trivializes any locally constant proetale sheaf of finitely presented modules, and the etale proetale comparison counit is an isomorphism on a constant etale chart.
mathlib_searches.verdict: Constant-sheaf adjunction counits are not etale/pro-etale comparison counits. No exact comparison statement found.

theorem coefficientFpLocalSystem_etaleCover (X : Scheme.{u})
    (A : Type (max v (u + 1))) [CommRing A]
    (F : Sheaf (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X)
      (ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A))
    (hF : ∀ V : Scheme.coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X,
      ∃ S : Sieve V, S ∈ Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X V ∧
        ∀ (U : Scheme.coefficientProEtaleSiteModel.{u, v} X) (f : U ⟶ V), S f →
          ∃ M : ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A, Module.FinitePresentation A M ∧
            Nonempty (F.over U ≅
              (constantSheaf ((Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X).over U)
                (ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A)).obj M)) :
    ∃ (I : Type (max v (u + 1)))
      (V : I → Scheme.smallModelComparisonEtaleSite.{u, v} X),
      (Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X).CoversTop
        (fun i ↦ (Scheme.smallModelComparisonInclusion.{u, v} X).obj (V i)) ∧
      ∀ i : I, ∃ M : ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A,
        Module.FinitePresentation A M ∧
          Nonempty (F.over ((Scheme.smallModelComparisonInclusion.{u, v} X).obj (V i)) ≅
            (constantSheaf ((Scheme.coefficientProEtaleModelTopology.{u, v} X).over
              ((Scheme.smallModelComparisonInclusion.{u, v} X).obj (V i)))
              (ModuleCat.{max v (u + 1)} A)).obj M)
